people.name: Ahab
people.line: Wicked king of Israel; husband of Jezebel

people.name: Jehu
people.line: Son of Jehoshaphat, king of Israel, destroyed Ahab's dynasty.

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

people.name: Samaria
people.line: Capital city of the northern kingdom of Israel; Samaritan inhabitants

translations.web: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. Jehu wrote letters, and sent to Samaria, to the rulers of Jezreel, even the elders, and to those who brought up Ahab’s sons, saying,
translations.bsb: Now Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria. So Jehu wrote letters and sent them to Samaria to the officials of Jezreel, to the elders, and to the guardians of the sons of Ahab, saying:
